data.title: A2 · 避难所的雨
data.description: 夜雨落在避难所窗外。A2 穿着宽松衬衫倚坐窗台，膝上搭着毯子，望着被雨洗净的街道。
data.action: 倚坐在废弃工厂避难所破损窗框边缘，冷峻注视着酸雨流淌成河
data.lighting: 窗外冷光与室内微弱灯光
data.promptProse: Sitting on the deep concrete windowsill of a ruined high-rise building with a dark blanket draped across her lap, A2 watches rain fall over the overgrown city ruins outside. Soft light from the storm-swept sky highlights the wet window frame and distant abandoned skyline.
data.animaCaption: A blanket lies across her knees.
